課程綱要.課程目標: 本課程的目標是提供來自不同背景的學生學習與臨床相關的腫瘤學知識。課程包括癌症生物學，癌症的臨床診斷/治療概論，以及癌症臨床研究。期望學生可以從了解實際臨床醫學而對研究方向有所啟發。
課程綱要.授課內容:
“Clinical oncology: learning from patients, the science of medicine
Public health
-Cancer epidemiology and risk factors
-Screening and prevention
Cancer biology
-Understanding cancer diversity
-The evolution of cancer
-Benign, malignancy, and metastasis
-Molecular and genetic basis
-Familial cancers and genetic testing
Cancer diagnosis
-Histopathology, cytology and tumor markers
-Staging and imaging
Treatment
-General principles
-Radiotherapy: Principles of radiotherapy; Medical physics in radiotherapy
-Principles of systemic therapy
-Principles of surgery
-Principles of palliative care
Patient management
-Multidisciplinary management
-Quality of life, therapeutic ration, and costs
Medical ethics
Human malignancies
-Head and neck cancers
-Lung cancer
-Breast cancer
-Cervical cancer
-Prostate cancer
-Colorectal cancer
-Liquid tumors
Clinical research
-Translational medicine
-Clinical trials“
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: “1.Bethesda handbook of clinical oncology, The 4th edition. 2.The Basic Science of Oncology, 2013.“
課程綱要.彈性教學說明: 依授課教師課堂上說明

課程綱要.開課單位: 生醫科學與工程學系系統生物與生物資訊碩士班
課程綱要.課程名稱(中文): 生成式人工智慧於生醫領域的應用
課程綱要.課程名稱(英文): Generative AI and its biomedical applications
課程綱要.授課內容:
Week 1 History of AI development
Week 2 Artificial neural networks (MLP, RNN, CNN) and deep learning
Week 3 Transformers and scaling law
Week 4 Supervised learning and unsupervised learning
Week 5 Large language models (LLMs)
Week 6 Reinforcement learning, transfer learning, distillation
Week 7 LLM hallucination, prompt engineering
Week 8 Context engineering
Week 9 Retrieval augmented generation (RAG)
Week 10 Evaluation and application of RAGs
Week 11 AI agents
Week 12 AI models for image understanding
Week 13 AI models of image generation and editing
Week 14 Multi-modal LLMs
Week 15 Humanoid robotics
Week 16 Multi-agent AI systems
課程綱要.教科書/參考書: M Pagano & K Gauvreau, Principles of Biostatistics, 2nd Ed. Brook/Cole, Belmont, CA, USA, 2000 T Glover & K Mitchell, An Introduction to Biostatistics, 2nd Ed. Waveland Press Inc. Long Grove, IL, USA, 2008
課程綱要.彈性教學說明: 依授課教師課堂上說明
課程綱要.課程領域: 專業語文表達領域 、 專業知識領域 、 計算分析領域

核心能力.評量方式: 紙筆測驗/會考 ， 口頭報告/口試
